note: Categories matter more than the raw list. 'stalkerware' is software sold for covert monitoring of another adult; 'employee_monitoring' and 'parental_control' are legitimate products that are routinely repurposed for abuse; 'remote_access' tools are ordinary IT software that gives someone else full control of the machine. Only the first category is inherently a finding — the rest are reported with the context needed to judge them.

entries.name: FlexiSPY
entries.description: Covert monitoring software that captures messages, calls, location, and ambient audio, and is marketed explicitly for monitoring partners.

entries.name: mSpy
entries.description: Covert monitoring suite that records keystrokes, messages, browsing, and location, and hides itself from the person being monitored.

entries.name: Hoverwatch
entries.description: Hidden monitoring software that logs keystrokes, screenshots, and webcam images without notifying the user.

entries.name: Cocospy
entries.description: Covert monitoring service marketed for tracking partners and family members.

entries.name: uMobix
entries.description: Covert monitoring service capturing messages, calls, and screen activity.

entries.name: Spyzie
entries.description: Covert monitoring service marketed for silent tracking of another person's device.

entries.name: TheTruthSpy
entries.description: Covert monitoring service; its own servers have leaked victim data repeatedly.

entries.name: XNSPY
entries.description: Covert monitoring suite advertised for partner and employee surveillance.

entries.name: iKeyMonitor
entries.description: Keylogger and screen recorder marketed for covert monitoring.

entries.name: ClevGuard / KidsGuard
entries.description: KidsGuard Pro records keystrokes, screenshots, and messages while hiding its presence.

entries.name: KidsGuard Pro
entries.description: Covert monitoring product that hides its icon and runs invisibly.

entries.name: Spyrix

entries.name: Refog Personal Monitor
entries.description: Hidden keylogger and screen recorder sold for monitoring family members.

entries.name: Ardamax Keylogger
entries.description: Stealth keylogger that runs invisibly and emails captured keystrokes.

entries.name: Spytech SpyAgent
entries.description: Stealth monitoring suite recording keystrokes, screenshots, and application use.

entries.name: Realtime-Spy
entries.description: Remote monitoring product that installs silently and reports to a web dashboard.

entries.name: PC Tattletale

entries.name: WebWatcher
entries.description: Covert monitoring product recording messages, browsing, and screenshots.

entries.name: Elite Keylogger

entries.name: Perfect Keylogger
entries.description: Stealth keylogger with remote log delivery.

entries.name: Aobo Keylogger
entries.description: Invisible keylogger for macOS and Windows sold for covert monitoring.

entries.name: KidLogger
entries.description: Monitoring software that records keystrokes, applications, and screenshots in the background.

entries.name: Actual Keylogger
entries.description: Hidden keystroke recorder.

entries.name: Teramind
entries.description: Workplace monitoring agent recording screen, keystrokes, and application use. Expected on a company-managed computer; on a personal machine it means someone is watching everything done on it.

entries.name: ActivTrak
entries.description: Workplace activity monitoring agent capturing screenshots and application use.

entries.name: Veriato / Cerberus
entries.description: Employee monitoring suite with covert recording modes.

entries.name: InterGuard
entries.description: Employee monitoring agent that can run invisibly to the user.

entries.name: StaffCop
entries.description: Employee monitoring suite recording screen, keystrokes, and files.

entries.name: Kickidler
entries.description: Employee monitoring agent with continuous screen recording.

entries.name: Hubstaff
entries.description: Time-tracking agent that can capture periodic screenshots. Normal on a work machine when the person knows it is installed.

entries.name: Time Doctor
entries.description: Time-tracking agent with optional screenshot capture.

entries.name: Qustodio
entries.description: Parental control software. Legitimate for a child's device; on an adult's own computer it gives whoever set it up a log of their activity.

entries.name: Net Nanny
entries.description: Parental control and content filtering software with activity reporting.

entries.name: Bark
entries.description: Parental monitoring service that reports messages and browsing to an account owner.

entries.name: TeamViewer
entries.description: Remote control software. Useful and common — and it gives whoever holds the credentials complete control of the machine, including watching the screen. Check whether unattended access is enabled and who is on its trusted-devices list.

entries.name: AnyDesk
entries.description: Remote control software frequently installed by tech-support scammers and left behind afterwards.

entries.name: ScreenConnect / ConnectWise Control
entries.description: Remote support agent very commonly abused for persistent unauthorised access, because it installs as a service and reconnects on its own.

entries.name: NetSupport Manager
entries.description: Remote control product routinely repackaged as malware ('NetSupport RAT') and installed silently.

entries.name: Remote Utilities
entries.description: Remote access product commonly used for persistent covert access.

entries.name: Ammyy Admin
entries.description: Remote access tool strongly associated with support scams and unauthorised access.

entries.name: DWAgent
entries.description: Unattended remote access agent that runs as a service.

entries.name: LogMeIn
entries.description: Unattended remote access service.

entries.name: Splashtop
entries.description: Remote desktop service with unattended access.

entries.name: RealVNC
entries.description: Remote screen access server.

entries.name: TightVNC
entries.description: VNC server, often installed silently to provide hidden screen access.

entries.name: UltraVNC
entries.description: VNC server, often installed silently to provide hidden screen access.

entries.name: Radmin
entries.description: Remote administration server providing full control of the machine.

entries.name: Atera agent
entries.description: Remote management agent; abused by intruders because it is signed, silent, and grants full remote control.
